tools.description: Use for everything about one ad: the hook, offer, landing page and whether the page delivers what the ad promises. Add include=full for scenes, transcript, overlays and narrative.

Use for how a market advertises: the share of hooks, personas, offers or formats across a vertical, brand or filter. Run it twice, once with min_impressions=4, to see what the winning ads over-index on.

Use to find companies by attribute - industry, headcount, funding stage, location - rather than to look one up you can already name. Each returned company costs 50 credits. Smaller pages reduce payload size.

Match a known company using identifiers with the premium product. Name matching is global and cannot be narrowed by country, so for non-US or ambiguous names also send the website domain as domain, or the LinkedIn company page URL as social_url.

To collect a whole table for a state: e.g. CAINC1 line 3 (per capita personal income) for every Montana county, all years; or CAINC5N earnings by industry for every county, latest year. Follow next_cursor until it is null.
Start here when the 4x4 dataset id is unknown: find the dataset, then call `dataset` for its columns and `rows` for its data. Only results with type `dataset` (and a non-null api_url) have rows.
Match a known person using identifiers with the premium-no-contact product. Contact entitlement comes from the dedicated credential, never from field projection.
Match a known person using identifiers with the premium-with-contact product. Contact entitlement comes from the dedicated credential, never from field projection.
List a channel's live streams, upcoming streams/premieres and stream replays, paged by continuation.

List a channel's Shorts, newest first, paged by continuation.
List a channel's uploads, newest first, paged by continuation.
Read a comment thread after video_comments.
List the videos in a public playlist, paged by continuation.

import { View, ActivityIndicator } from 'react-native'
import { useVehicleState, SyncStatus } from '@hooks/useVehicleState'
import { Dashboard } from '@components/Dashboard'

export const HomeScreen = () => {
  const { vehicleState, syncStatus } = useVehicleState()

  if (syncStatus === SyncStatus.PENDING) {
    return <ActivityIndicator size="large" />
  }

  return (
    <View>
      <Dashboard state={vehicleState} syncStatus={syncStatus} />
    </View>
  )
}
